statement: HM-01 ProvenanceLab: Reproducible Molecule Analysis with Evidence Checks

requirements.requirement: Reject malformed/unsupported inputs without invented numbers
Precise input diagnostic categories and ambiguity flags
Molecular identity under an explicit policy
requirements.scope: Exact canonical graph identity; no parent/tautomer equivalence claim
Fixtures and repeatability on the current locked host
Unsupported graphs and absent predictions stay unassessed; field completeness is a separate gap

requirements.requirement: Separate not computed/not available/not applicable at property level
Frozen PubChem and ChEMBL record snapshots
Exactly replay any historical run from an exported package

detail.observation: Unsupported input is safely rejected, but distinct causes are collapsed.

detail.observation: Unspecified double-bond geometry stays unspecified in SMILES; no explicit E/Z ambiguity item is emitted.

detail.scope: Software fixture only, not predictive accuracy

detail.observation: Descriptor fields are absent for unsupported inputs, although row identity and policy abstentions are retained.

undefined_denominator_example.reason: Computed descriptor; not a predictive assessment

detail.observation: Broken-ring MW has no field record; unavailable affinity has an execution status; H2 aromatic-heavy-atom fraction is undefined but reports unsupported_input/undetermined. UI reduces absent numeric fields to Not assessed. Validation not_applicable is a different concept.

detail.scope: One Windows host and locked interpreter; no cross-platform claim.
Manual harness recomputation using private stored request and current installed runtime, not a product replay command.

detail.observation: Original spelling OCC is held only in the private job payload; export has CCO and the hash of OCC.

source.unknown_reason: User supplied; no verified source accession

detail.observation: Active demo is a local SMILES list, not source-ID-bound PubChem/ChEMBL compound records. Retained AID1030 study files are assay descriptions, not this workflow's compound snapshot.
